request: Fix the four defects that make the code-review gate mis-measure its input. (1) assemble-context.mjs builds changedFiles from `git diff --name-only HEAD`, so every file a change CREATES is invisible to the code-structure and backlog-deferral checkers; union in `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` with prior: null. (2) The same run reports inputState `measured` when it saw only the tracked half, so a partial review is indistinguishable from a complete one. (3) swarm_wave_audit.mjs runs `git status --porcelain` without -uall, so a wholly-new untracked directory collapses to one path string that never matches the file-level union write_set and false-fails the wave. (4) simplify/oracle.mjs tableRowCells splits a verdict row on `|`, so a path containing a pipe shifts every cell and the row is silently dropped; a newline in a filename does the same one layer up in assembleChangedFiles's `.split('\n')`. Reported by a user of the installed baseline; shipped consumers carry the identical code. Needs failing tests first.
novelty_evidence: Four open backlog entries name these defects and prescribe the fix shape. `.claude/memory/backlog/untracked-files-are-invisible-to-every-code-review-checker-7f21.md` ("Union the probe with `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`, then decide what `prior` means for a path with no HEAD version", verified-at 2367f5e) and `fanout-changedfiles-omits-untracked-files-6b07.md` ("Union in `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`, with `prior: null` for each", verified-at a163ec5) both measure the cost on named runs. `swarm-wave-audit-collapses-untracked-dirs-4c19.md` names the one-flag fix ("Add `-uall` to the `spawnSync` args at line 72", verified-at 7f7b582). `a-pipe-in-a-filename-removes-its-row-from-the-review-gate-5c04.md` names the delimiter fix and its sibling newline case in assembleChangedFiles (verified-at 2367f5e). Re-confirmed on disk at e27219d: `assemble-context.mjs:26` still reads ['diff','--name-only','HEAD'], and obj/template carries the same line.
